checks: Pinned Hint/Submit are visible and unobstructed with the default floating judge at five desktop sizes
Escape closes hints and reset confirmation; focus returns to the persistent opener
Title double-click toggles maximize and its accessible state; Execute has a clean name and shortcuts
Keyboard Execute rejects syntax errors without completion credit
DDL is rejected without creating a table; Query menu exposes the Execute shortcut
Qualified CTE wildcard points to the line-five star, not the statement start
Grading shows specific missing columns, per-dataset expected/actual counts, and familiar SQL types
Comparison requires a correct answer, exposes visible progress and cancellation, and saves no extra attempt
Format SQL reflows as one undo step and refuses unparseable SQL
Go to Line resolves to the editor's own panel and moves the caret
Documented shortcuts are generated from the menu accelerator table
Grid sorting derives a new query and leaves the displayed rows alone
Query history recalls executed SQL without running it, across reloads
Editor/results split derives from the window until the learner chooses
